    • forbidSequence

      public static Rule forbidSequence(String fromCategory, String toCategory)
      Creates a Rule forbidding a toCategory shift on the day right after a fromCategory shift for the same employee (for example no "MORNING" after "NIGHT").

      Unlike minRestBetweenShifts(Duration), which measures the clock gap between two shifts, this rule is categorical and day-based: it applies whatever the shift times are.
